name: Soldier of Fortune: Platinum Edition
description: Soldier of Fortune: Platinum Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter, an edition of the first game in the Soldier of Fortune series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Soldier of Fortune plays its sound through defsnd.dll out of the box, which has no EAX — only EAXSnd.dll does.
